translated: The Vulture Regional Natural Park is a protected natural area established in November 2017. This regional park includes the Vulture area as well as part of the municipal territories of Atella, Barile, Ginestra, Melfi, Rapolla, Rionero in Vulture, Ripacandida, Ruvo del Monte and San Fele, all belonging to the Province of Potenza.
